name: Privacy Core
description: OpenClaw Private governance: run gate, egress allowlist, CEL action policy (decide, record, then act), the door between gateways, take-the-wheel, privacy audit.

cliCommands.name: privacy
cliCommands.description: Privacy posture, take-the-wheel, and agent memory

mode.description: private turns this gateway into the private house: attested or local models only, sandbox on, allowlisted plugins and egress, A2A as the only channel. standard (default) changes nothing.

residency.description: eu restricts every agent to providers whose region is eu or local.

providers.description: Operator-declared regions for providers this pack does not know. Region only: a declaration never makes a provider attested. Confirm with the vendor's contract first.

allow.description: Extra hosts a private gateway may reach (exact lowercase hostnames, or *.example.com).

proxyPort.description: Loopback port of the egress proxy. Default 19930. proxy.proxyUrl must be http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

policy.description: CEL action policy. Deny is evaluated first, then approve, then allow.

skills.description: Skill approval. An agent run is refused while a skill folder the gateway loads for it has a fingerprint that is not approved. Always required in private mode.

approval.description: required turns skill approval on for a standard gateway. Private mode always requires it.

approved.description: Approved fingerprints per skill name. Written by openclaw privacy skills approve; do not edit by hand.

sandbox.description: Private mode only. required (default): private agents run their tools in a Docker or Podman container. off (lite mode, no Docker): private agents may have no shell, file, browser or computer tools.
